RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything. Panels skew by who's available in senior HR and leadership roles; composition alone predicts nothing about outcome, and raising it would frame you as someone attributing a loss to the decision-makers' sex rather than the decision's merits.

Note also that "head of group" is a leadership and client-facing role. Eight years plus "excellent client relationships" can legitimately beat fifteen years of design depth — that's a plausible, non-discriminatory read of the stated facts.

The real issue is the unanswered request. Chase it in writing, politely, citing your two-week-old request, and ask for specific feedback on how you were scored against the criteria. If the substance later reveals something, you'll have a documented record.
